Companhia Metropolitano de São Paulo (.k.. METRÔ) publishes monthly demand reports data transparency portal. Reports cover Lines 1 (Azul/Blue), 2 (Verde/Green), 3 (Vermelha/Red), 5 (Lilás/Lilac, Jul 2018), 15 (Prata/Silver), available January 2016 onward. Values reported thousands (milhares). 2020, monthly reports published monthly PDF csv files. csv files start October 2017; first nine months 2017 exist PDFs transcribed hand package (see 2017 source formats). individual file contains table (metric) specific year-month. three pieces information available month: 1) average number entries station, business days (station_averages); 2) number passenger entries per line (passengers_entrance); 3) number transported passengers per line (passengers_transported). 2020 onwards, monthly reports started published annual PDF csv files updated monthly. Also, new report published contained daily number entrances per station (station_daily). PDF csv files poorly structured, part metrosp exists. data public hard use: format, encoding, layout csv files shift release release, year report needs import strategy. fragility produced processing errors past. pipeline now runs set checks every build, errors may still slip — find one, please open issue GitHub repository. Going back datasets, ’s important note monthly passenger report breaks demand five day-type metrics: total (monthly aggregate), average business days, average Saturdays, average Sundays, daily peak (maximum within month). aggregated METRO. Daily station-level data (one row per station per day) available 2020 onwards. Stations integrations lines always present total daily entrance plus transfers lines. example, Paraíso Line 1 presents station entries plus transfers Line 2. Paraíso Line 2 presents entries station plus transfers Line 1. Finally, METRO produces data lines 1, 2, 3, 5, 15. Line 5 initially operated METRO SP later passed ViaMobilidade (see ). Lines 4 (Amarela/Yellow, operated ViaQuatro) 5 (Lilás/Lilac, operated ViaMobilidade August 2018) published METRO portal. Ridership data lines comes Insper Dataverse, starting January 2012 (Line 4) August 2018 (Line 5). Transported counts available Lines 4 5. Unlike METRO data, Dataverse counts rounded nearest thousand. ETL therefore multiplies METRO values 1,000, every dataset combines two sources reports individual passengers. passengers_transported draws METRO alone keeps source unit, thousands passengers. station_averages dataset Lines 4 5 derived station_daily using bizdays package “Brazil/ANBIMA” calendar, tracks days B3 stock exchange operates São Paulo. calendar closely mirrors city’s business-day schedule, one caveat: since 2022 B3 closes national holidays, municipal state ones 9th July. package ships calendar_spo, São Paulo calendar mark holidays, analyses need finer distinction. title: Getting Started

Data newer snapshot published data-latest GitHub release. four main datasets: passengers_entrance: monthly passengers entering metro system, line passengers_transported: monthly passengers transported metro system, line station_averages: monthly average weekday passengers per station station_daily: daily passengers per station convenience, metrosp also provides information stations lines metro system (lines stations). lines dataset spatial dataset requires sf package work properly; carries line numbers Portuguese/English line names full network (including planned CPTM lines). package also provides named vector colors line metro system (metro_colors), station opening dates (station_inauguration), São Paulo holiday business-day calendar (calendar_spo).
